description: One SessionStart command hook (`agent-exec hook session-start`) injects the routing protocol, or the worker notice in a hosted worker's tree, at startup, resume, clear and compact; it is a command hook, so it runs where cc-plugin-sec-default holds every classic.* mod event, and it is the only hook that re-injects after a compaction. It stamps the session so `agent-exec doctor` reports a skipped hook, and it fails open (a missing or unbuildable agent-exec is reported by doctor, not shown at every session start). The hooks module (orchestra.ts) listens only to events Claude Code does not hold from user-tier mods (tool.call, turn.start/turn.complete, prompt.submit, session.end, plus the HUD's own), so it works where cc-plugin-sec-default is seated, and it stamps the session too. It denies starting long-running work from any shell (agent-exec wave run outside the orchestra-wave agent's --detach, claude -p/--print, agent-exec dispatch without --detach; ORCHESTRA_LAUNCH_GUARD); asks the main thread to re-route once a turn hand-edits enforcement.turn_edits distinct files, the nudge riding on the edit's tool result; denies orchestration agents until the user opts in or answers the one ask (enforcement.opt_in); denies merging, rebasing, resetting, pushing or branching from an orchestra/* branch outside an orchestra worktree, and merge commits of Agent worktree-* branches, loops and variable operands included, and points to `agent-exec isolate land` (enforcement.orchestra_merge); guards worker subagents against destructive VCS and the shared git stash (enforcement.worker_vcs), against writing the main working tree while they own a worktree (enforcement.worker_tree), against a second writer in a leased worktree (enforcement.worktree_lease), and against running the whole test suite (ORCHESTRA_TEST_GUARD); denies Agent, Task and Workflow calls while the plan's five-hour usage window is at or above enforcement.usage_guard (ORCHESTRA_USAGE_GUARD; orchestra-wave and orchestra-relay are exempt, and `[orchestra:allow-usage: <reason>]` in a main-thread Agent call lifts it twice per session); caps an orchestra-planner to orchestra-scout and orchestra-checker children, their count, concurrency and tool calls (enforcement.fanout, ORCHESTRA_FANOUT_GUARD; no per-call escape); denies SendMessage to an agent whose context reached enforcement.resume_max_tokens (ORCHESTRA_RESUME_GUARD; `[orchestra:allow-resume: <reason>]` once per agent, otherwise spawn a fresh agent with a handoff); the module runs its own plugin's bin/agent-exec, never the one on PATH; releases the lease on each subagent turn's end and removes the session's clean orchestra worktrees at session.end (enforcement.session_cleanup); admits worker heavy commands machine-wide (throttle.heavy_slots, tests on throttle.test_slots); nudges once per session against generalist subagents that inherit the session model or name Fable (enforcement.opus_generalist) and, opt-in, direct Haiku spawns (enforcement.light_class); and shows running orchestra agents and the waves the orchestra-wave watcher (or an allowed main-thread launch) starts in the status line, a detail pane (only when asked: /orchestra:progress toggles it, its own button closes it) and a band above the prompt, toasting each new wave need (userConfig hud). Every guard has a switch or an escape hatch and fails open
